verifications.claim: The Artemis II crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego on Friday, April 10, 2026, at 8:07 p.m. ET.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'splash down off the coast of San Diego at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT) on Friday, April 10'; R2: 'splashdown, at 8:07 p.m. Eastern time, ... off San Diego'; R4: 'splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego at 8:07 p.m. EDT'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm date, location, and time in ET/EDT.

verifications.claim: The splashdown occurred at 5:07 p.m. PT.
